notes.title: Playtest #2

notes.title: Playtest #1
notes.notes:
It’s time! ⏳
Our first Steam playtest will be live from 05/06 until 15/06/2025! 🗓️

Get ready to play some Galactic Vault! 🤖🔫
From 20:00 CEST 05/06, you’ll be able to download and play directly from your steam library (You will get a notification if you signed up 🔔).

There will also be some devs online in discord to answer any questions or just play a bit too! Feel free to join: [url=https://discord.gg/xzNvYEp2ms]Discord[/url]

Please note that this is a playtest, while we did our best to deliver a very polished and fun build there is still some missing features and there will be bugs 🐞.

If you encounter a bug, please report it in: ⁠🐞[url=https://discord.com/channels/1011227918921367553/1378745978290569361]Discord | Bugs[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3585460/discussions/]Galactic Vault | Discussions[/url]
If you have suggestions or ideas, let us know in: ⁠💡[url=https://discord.com/channels/1011227918921367553/1378746948936400986]Discord | Suggestions[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3585460/discussions/]Galactic Vault | Discussions[/url]

Now invite all your friends and prepare to play Galactic Vault 💥
